sn55.22:1.1: sutaṁ- → this phrase in B1-2 only. -- The numbers 1,2,3 do not differ from those of the preceding sutta. (pts note)
sn55.22:1.4: bāhujaññaṁ → bahujaññaṁ (sya-all) | sambādhabyūhaṁ → sambādhaviyūhaṁ (sya-all) | idaṁ → idha (bj: sī.pavi) | Idam → S1-3 idha. (pts note) | Kapilavatthu- → B2 kappīla- always S1-3 -vatthuṁ. (pts note)
sn55.22:1.5: manobhāvanīye → manobhāvanīyaṁ (bj) | bhikkhū → bhikkhuṁ (bj) | sāyanhasamayaṁ → sāyaṇhasamayaṁ (sya-all)
sn55.22:2.2: kālaṅkiriyā → kālakiriyā (bj, sya-all) | kālaṅkiriyā catūhi → kālakiriyā catuhi (pts) | te → put after maraṇaṁ in S1-3. (pts note)
sn55.22:3.1: mūlacchinno → mūle chinno (bj); mūle chinne (sya-all, pts) | pācīnaninno → pācinaninno (pts) | papateyyāti → mūle chinne (bj: syā); mūlacchinno (bj: machasaṁ) | pācinaninno → S1 rūpocīnaninno instead of rukkho pācī- (pts note) | chinne → S1-3 chinno. (pts note) | ti → S3 pateyyā ti. (pts note)
sn55.22:3.3: nibbānaninno hoti → nibbhānaninno (pts) | nibbānapabbhāroti dutiyaṁ → nibbānapabbhāro ti (pts)
